🍫 Welcome to +1 Speed Keyboard Escape | Candy & Chocolate! 🍫

⚡ Every step = +1 Speed

💪 Train your speed and unlock powerful multipliers
👥 Race against friends and other players
🌍 Become the FASTEST on the server
🚀 Speed is everything… but one wrong move and you’re back at the start 😱

🎧 ASMR vibes included
Smooth movement, satisfying keyboard clicks, creamy visuals, and relaxing candy sounds for a perfect mix of speed & chill ✨
